# Employers4Change (E4C)

> E4C is a SaaS platform connecting employers, students, and schools through recruitment, upskilling, and intern talent management with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and skills-based hiring.

Based in Orlando, Employers4Change operates an internship platform that combines employer membership, student mentorship through the Intern Pursuit Game, and educational partnerships. The platform emphasizes power skills development, ethical AI matching, and workforce inclusion through the E4C Pledge program.

## Key Topics

- Internship Platform
- Talent Development
- Diversity & Inclusion
- Intern Management
- Skills-Based Hiring
- AI Matching
- Mentoring & Reverse Mentoring
- Employer Membership
- E4C Academy
- E4C Pledge
- Pre-Employment Assessments
- Workforce Inclusion
- DOL Compliance
- Power Skills
- Intern Recruitment

## Platform Overview

- [Upskilling | Employers4Change](https://www.e4c.tech): Employers4Change SaaS platform for recruitment, upskilling, and intern talent management
- [Employers | Employers4Change](https://www.e4c.tech/employers): Employer membership and intern management platform features and benefits
- [Students | Employers4Change](https://www.e4c.tech/students): Student signup and benefits for Intern Pursuit Game and mentorship
- [Internships | Florida | Employers4Change](https://www.e4c.tech/schools): School and educational institution partnerships for internship programs

## Membership & Programs

- [Membership | Employers4Change](https://www.e4c.tech/membership): E4C membership pricing tiers and plans for employers and nonprofits
- [E4C Program | Employers4Change](https://www.e4c.tech/e4c-program): E4C employer pledge program with badge system and workforce inclusion
- [Learn More | Employers4Change](https://www.e4c.tech/learn-more): E4C Academy, E4C Pledge, and resources for intern management and leadership

## Tools & Resources
